question: Please teach me how to talk cleverly enough that I won't be killed when I encounter each of the Sin Archbishops.
answer:
If you argue back against a Sin Archbishop, you'll die, so turning your back and running away is probably your best chance of not getting killed.

Basically, when you respond to those guys, you'll get things like:

“I wanna eat youuu.”
“That's love, isn't it!”
“Hey, you know…”
“You'd actually talk to little old me?!”

So…

Run faster than all the other people around you who are running away! Run and escape!
